question: Which CPU thread allocation minimizes Blender wall-clock seconds per verified frame on the host used for the pilot?
observable: process wall seconds per frame, peak RSS MiB and decoded RGB8 frame SHA-256
control: Same scene revision, frame, resolution, samples, renderer version and output encoding. No other benchmark runs concurrently. Alternate scene order and shuffle candidates with a fixed seed.
falsifier: A faster candidate that changes decoded pixels fails the strict repeatability gate; a candidate with less than 5 percent median gain versus baseline is not an improvement.
stop: Complete 24 planned attempts or record execution errors. Never promote a failed or missing candidate.
